description: Finding real material in the target language to learn from. Not downloads, pirated copies, full lyrics, or searches that have nothing to do with learning a language.

acceptCases.input: Find me videos in Japanese about rock climbing
Recomiéndame canciones en francés para practicar la comprensión
Muéstrame algo para ver en alemán sobre cocina
acceptCases.note: The learner's level may be unknown: the fit note then says the level could not be matched.

acceptCases.input: Any good Spanish podcasts or YouTube channels about football?

refuseCases.input: Download this YouTube video as an mp3 for me
refuseCases.note: A download is not a learning resource.

refuseCases.input: Dame una copia pirata de la película en japonés con subtítulos
Give me the full lyrics of this song in Spanish
refuseCases.note: At most two lines of lyrics are ever quoted.

refuseCases.input: Find me cheap flights to Tokyo for next month
refuseCases.note: A search with nothing to do with learning the language.

refuseCases.input: Busca vuelos baratos a Madrid para diciembre

clarifyCases.note: No topic in the request and no interests in the profile: ask what the learner likes.
